compatibility.api: API 1.3.0 adds default-off read-only UCP catalog POST operations. Existing HTTP GET, MCP and A2A contracts stay compatible.
compatibility.mcp: MCP 1.3.1 retains its four anonymous read-only tools and existing schemas. UCP shares their catalog authority without adding transactional tools.
compatibility.sdk: SDK 0.3.0 adds typed UCP discovery/catalog reads and a local purchase-link helper. Existing methods remain compatible; both compatibility packages pin exactly 0.3.0.
compatibility.skill: Skill 1.3.0 adds UCP catalog and human checkout guidance while preserving MIT-0 and the existing HTTP/MCP/A2A fallback.
compatibility.a2a: A2A 1.0.0 keeps the existing stateless JSON-RPC direct-Message profile and signed isolated acceptance evidence. No transport or admission behavior changes.
compatibility.website: Website 1.2.0 adds a default-off single-domain purchase-link resolver. The buyer still chooses and completes the existing checkout.
compatibility.ucp: Application adapter 1.0.0 implements UCP protocol 2026-08-25 catalog search, lookup and permalink. No checkout, orders, identity or payment handlers. Production activation and real-platform acceptance remain pending.
